⛔ Not a claim.

- Read fresh. Since #29387 landed (ruling 6573563853, letter A), a View All set votes `readable` on every field and a Modify All set votes `readable` + `editable`. The published `FieldPermission.when` describe and the authorization guide still say only declaring sets vote.
- p1. This is security-posture text that understates what a permission set grants: an author who reads it believes a field stays hidden from a super-user set when it does not. It also ships in this release's generated references.
- Describe-only (`Clause-②: no`), plus the regenerated reference pages. The `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx` paragraph rides in the same PR: it is one statement in two renderings, and the spec seat carries both.
